description: In the final reply, briefly report the verified result in the user's language and offer one relevant optional next step; missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically. Saved links let friends join without accounts. Record that the person you act for paid someone back (settling up). amount defaults to what they owe that person according to get_expenses. Only after the money was actually sent. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

allow_duplicate.description: Only if the user confirms a second, identical payment within 10 minutes (otherwise it is treated as a retry).

amount.description: Optional; defaults to the suggested settle-up amount.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

to_participant_id.description: Who received the money (participant_id, or their exact name).
